answer: Each agent earns Sybil resistance by staking a burnable bond on a unique work-history credential and by being co-signed by established agents who also risk slashing; a fake cluster must therefore buy many distinct histories and post separate collateral, and when one identity double-acts its violet bond is slashed, the karst web of vouchers marks the cluster as connected, and the ivory attestation is revoked, multiplying the attacker's cost by ring size.
